searchText: How often does the BASEFEE adjust? every block, see the calculation (and the linked spec) 4 comments above Thank you what's the latest thought on hardcoding the block gas limit under 1559? I strongly believe it only introduces paths to abuse (eg. bloating state in favor of maximizing MEV opportunities, arbitrarily adjustments as retaliation) rather than benefits (i can't think of any). I know <@!528251935829262351> and <@!278762485497069569> would echo this as well. EIP 1559 should have a hardcoded block gas limit 👍 or 👎 There are currently no plans to hardcode the gas limit. You could create an EIP for it if you want. A change in who controls the gas limit should **not** be part of 1559, as that is an unrelated technical change. It could be *released* at the same time as 1559, but that is a hard fork coordination thing, not an EIP thing. how is it unrelated? this is like saying the "BASE_FEE burn is an unrelated monetary policy change" and should be a separate EIP. isolating both the burn and hardcode divorce the EIP from its real world environment with motivated participants EIPs are purely technical, monetary policy is not. A large/complex overarching monetary policy change may involve several small independent technical changes, and that is fine. But each of those technical changes should be its own EIP. Will write a draft today for this
